prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with wrist fracture after a rear-end collision. The patient had 34 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1082; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a reported wrist fracture. The mechanism and force of the collision are consistent with the injury described. Examination findings support a wrist injury, while several other tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the same body region is known from the patient's history.

Care has been ongoing across 34 visits. Over successive months, the plan expanded, with additional visits and new services added over time. The total course of treatment has run longer and grown more extensive than is typically needed for a wrist fracture of this type. Billing records reviewed show no duplicate or repeated charges.

Recommend continued monitoring of the wrist, a review of the ongoing treatment plan against expected recovery milestones, and reassessment of functional goals at the next scheduled follow-up.
